MIND. [1] [Canth.]
Unconsciousness, lies with outstretched arms ; sudden starting up, screaming, throwing arms about. θ Metritis.
Sudden loss of consciousness with red face. θ Dentition.
Lies in a stupor with cold surface and occasional jerks.
Uremic coma, delirium and convulsions.
Forgetfulness.
Strange ideas crowd on him against his will.
Confusion ; distraction of mind ; inability to concentrate thought.
Confusion of head and pulsation in forehead, in morning.
Hallucinations, especially at night ; deliria of people long dead.
Furious delirium, with crying, barking and biting ; confusion of head, anxious restlessness ; cold sweat, especially on hands and feet.
Almost frenzied delirium.
Paroxysms of rage, renewed by sight of dazzling, bright objects, or touching larynx when trying to drink water.
Whining and complaining, with anxious restlessness, < from motion, > lying quiet.
Constantly attempting to do something, but accomplishing nothing.
Despondent and low-spirited, says she must die.
Fear, confusion of ideas, she could not think clearly. θ Vesical hemorrhoids.
Great amativeness ; amorous frenzy.
Unbounded frantic sexual desire. θ Mania.
Exceedingly sensitive to all impressions ; irritable and blaspheming. θ Traumatic neuralgia.
Insolent and contradictory mood, in afternoon.
Uneasiness day and night, with hot head.
Anxious restlessness, ending in rage.
Great restlessness, obliging him to move constantly ; great activity of mind.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Canth.]
Vertigo : and staggering ; and fainting ; while walking in open air, with transient attacks of unconsciousness ; appearance of fog before eyes.
Heaviness of head.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Canth.]
Soreness and burning in brain.
Dull heavy pain in forehead.
Confusion of head in morning with pulsations in forehead.
Burning in sides of head, ascending from neck, with soreness and giddiness ; < morning and afternoon ; when standing or sitting ; > while walking or lying down.
Stitches in side of head and occiput.
Painful tearing on vertex, with sensation as if some one was pulling a lock of hair upward.
Violent lancinating pains deep in brain, especially in occiput. θ Cerebro-spinal meningitis.
Heaviness in occiput, with drowsiness and incapacity to think.
Head and throbbing in head.
Sensation of fulness, with head rising up into head, with anxiousness.
Headache from washing or bathing.
Cerebro-spinal meningitis : paroxysms of rage and fury ; pain deep in brain, with an expression of great suffering ; base of brain is chief seat of pain ; urine dribbles or passes with burning-cutting pain.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Canth.]
Hair falls out when combing. θ During confinement or lactation.
Scales on scalp ; enormous dandruff.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Canth.]
Objects look yellow.
Eyes look yellow.
Burning in eyes and glowing heat, as from coals.
Biting sensation, as of salt in eyes.
Smarting in eyes.
Lachrymation in open air ; must close eyes ; on opening lids, margins pain as if sore, like raw flesh.
Inflammation of eyes, particularly when caused by a burn.
Eyes protruding ; fiery, sparkling, staring look.
Involuntary spasmodic movement of eyes.
Eyes sunken, surrounded by blue rings.
Eyes restlessly in motion, at times staring, always, however, with a frightful look ; pupils contracted. θ Acute mania.
Right eye looks bleared, congested, inflamed ; pain < night, cannot red then ; sight quite good ; commenced with feeling as of lashes in eye ; urine scalds.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Canth.]
Ringing, humming, or roaring in ears.
Tearing in right ear right mastoid process, as if bone would be torn out.
A hot exhalation passes, at intervals, and frequently, out from ears.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Canth.]
Coryza with pains in limbs ; also chronic coryza.
Erysipelatous inflammation of dorsum of nose, spreading to both cheeks, but more to right ; followed by desquamation.
Secretion of much tenacious mucus from nose, without sneezing ; hoarseness and painful hawking of tough mucus from chest ; nightly dry cutting stitches along trachea, externally.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Canth.]
Expression of extreme suffering, terror or despair.
Sunken, hippocratic countenance.
Deathlike look during and after the pains.
Face : hot, red and swollen ; swollen and puffy ; flushed when stooping ; yellow, or very pale.
Face fallen in ; cheeks bluish. θ Acute mania.
Erysipelas beginning on dorsum of nose and spreading to cheeks, more to right.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Canth.]
Dry lips without thirst.
The jaws tightly closed, almost approaching trismus, especially when they wished to give her water or medicine, which she prevented by angrily tossing about. θ Acute mania.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Canth.]
Grinding teeth. θ Meningitis. θ Typhus.
Painful red spot, size of a pin's head, over carious root of an upper incisor ; discharges pus from a small opening in centre, when pressed.
Gums spongy and swollen. θ Suppurative metritis.
Scurvy ; coagulated blood in mouth in morning on waking ; bloody urine.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Canth.]
Taste : bitter ; lost ; gold tooth-plate tastes coppery.
Speech weak and timorous.
Trembling of tongue.
Tongue fiery red. θ Facial erysipelas.
Tongue : thickly furred, red at edges ; swollen and thickly coated ; and back of mouth, in part excoriated, in part covered with blisters.
Inflammation of tongue with vesicles.
Sublingual glands swollen with vesicles.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Canth.]
Mucous membrane red and covered with small blisters.
Loss of epithelium on lips, tongue and palate. θ Dysentery.
Burning pain in mouth, throat and stomach.
Dryness in mouth.
Vesicles and cankers in mouth and throat. θ Dysentery.
Lining of mouth and throat covered with white blisters from size of pin's head to that of a bean.
Salivation : copious ; tasteless ; disgustingly sweet.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Canth.]
Expectoration of frothy saliva streaked with blood.
Mucus in posterior nares must be hawked into mouth to be discharged.
Burning sensation in throat, which feels as if on fire.
Burning in throat, with scraped sensation and spitting of blood.
Spasmodic constriction and intense pain at back of throat.
Throat inflamed and covered with plastic lymph.
Aphthous ulcer at back part of fauces, covered with a whitish adherent crust ; a similar one on right tonsil.
Throat swollen.
Swallowing very difficult. θ Tonsillitis.
Difficult deglutition with nocturnal regurgitation.
Water drunk regurgitates through nose. θ Sequel of burn.
Inflammation and suppuration of tonsils.
Diphtheria : dysuria ; urine contains shreds or coats of uriniferous tubuli ; extreme prostration, sinking, deathlike turns ; irritable looking rash upon skin or shining through epidermis.
Throat : < in afternoon and at night ; < while drinking and from wet poultices ; > while lying down.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Canth.]
Diminished appetite.
Canine hunger, particularly for meat.
Great thirst, with burning pain in throat and stomach.
Thirst, with aversion to all fluids.
Disgust for everything ; drink, food and tobacco.
Coffee disagrees.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Canth.]
After drinking coffee, sensation of fulness.
Drinking even small quantities of water, increases pain in bladder.
Great thirst, but drinking, or even sight of water, increases pain.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Canth.]
Empty eructations ; eructations of sour, frothy mucus, tinged bright red.
Nausea and vomiting.
Vomiting : of water drunk, also of blood ; greenish, offensive ; of bile and ingesta ; of frothy mucus, tinged bright red.
Vomiting, with violent retching and severe colic. θ Pregnancy.
Vomiting of bile. θ Phrenitis.
